name: iam:PassRole + glue:UpdateJob + glue:StartJobRun
description: Modify an existing Glue job to use a privileged role and a malicious script, then execute it to run code with the role's permissions. Stealthier than creating a new job because it blends with normal ETL maintenance activity.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass a role to glue.amazonaws.com
Must be able to update existing Glue job configurations
Must be able to start Glue job runs

additional.description: Helpful for retrieving current job configuration before modification
Useful for discovering existing Glue jobs that can be modified
Helpful for monitoring job execution details
Helpful for discovering available privileged roles to pass

admin: An existing Glue job must be present in the environment that can be modified
A role must exist that trusts glue.amazonaws.com and has administrative permissions
lateral: An existing Glue job must be present in the environment that can be modified
A role must exist that trusts glue.amazonaws.com with the desired permissions

references.title: Rhino Security Labs - AWS IAM Privilege Escalation

techniques: T1565.001 - Data Manipulation: Stored Data Manipulation

options.name: JOB_NAME
options.description: Name of the existing Glue job to modify

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the Glue job (must trust glue.amazonaws.com)

options.name: SCRIPT_S3_URI
options.description: S3 URI of the Glue script (e.g., s3://bucket/script.py). Auto-provisioned if attacker identity is set.

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for the Glue job

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Restore the original job configuration (role and script) after execution

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an existing IAM user or role via Glue job

payloads.name: backdoor/create-access-key
payloads.description: Create new access keys for an existing IAM user via Glue job

payloads.name: backdoor/create-role
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges and a custom trust policy via Glue job

payloads.name: backdoor/create-user
payloads.description: Create an IAM user with administrator privileges and access keys via Glue job

payloads.name: backdoor/update-role-trust
payloads.description: Update a role's trust policy to add a trusted principal via Glue job

payloads.name: exfil/cloudwatch
payloads.description: Extract execution role credentials and print to CloudWatch Logs via Glue job

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Exfiltrate execution role credentials to an attacker-controlled HTTPS endpoint via Glue job

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate execution role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket via Glue job

payloads.name: revshell/tls
payloads.description: Establish a TLS-encrypted reverse shell to the attacker listener's shell port via Glue job
